46.answer: Two tracks. Founding Stakeholders (3 Platinum, 5 Gold and 8 Silver slots) help shape the policy and deal agenda. Official Sponsors (1 Diamond, 3 Gold, 5 Silver and 10 Supporting slots) gain brand reach and leads. In-kind Talent and Ecosystem partnerships are also welcome. Fees are shared on request.

47.question: What does a Platinum Founding Stakeholder package include?
47.answer: A named place on the Post-Summit Policy Brief to the Presidency, curated one-on-one meetings with government and DFI leaders, a sector roundtable to chair, the VIP dinner with Federal Ministers and CEOs, a 15-minute keynote, a seat on the pre-summit working group, and nomination of up to 500 youths into the Talent Fund.

48.question: Is a Founding Stakeholder package sponsorship?
48.answer: No. Stakeholders pay a partnership fee to help set the agenda, not to buy logo space. Founding Stakeholder status is renewable annually for 10 years.

50.question: What does a Gold Founding Stakeholder package include?
50.answer: The Stakeholder benefits: a named place on the Policy Brief, curated meetings with government and DFI leaders, a roundtable seat, VIP dinner access, a panel speaking slot and Talent Fund nominations. Exact terms are in the partnership proposal, shared on request.
